components.name: Slide title
components.description: An isolated typography specimen, not a generated course slide.

components.name: Body text
components.description: An isolated typography specimen at the minimum body size.

narrative.overview: The agreed direction is calm, elegant, and minimalistic. Clear hierarchy, precise alignment, consistent spacing, and purposeful visuals support understanding. The existing template defines the visual identity; this document is the visual specification for Slidev and Impeccable.
